en-US: Build 201 internal device test. This replaces Build 200, whose cloud App compile found two Swift 6 errors before packaging or upload. Both are fixed: media model resolution now awaits its main-actor route, and the compact/regular Office toolbar uses concrete label-style branches. Build 199 and 200 were not uploaded. The rebuilt and source-verified Office host remains included. Please focus on: (1) Canvas nodes move when dragging the body/title with finger or trackpad; only visible corners resize. (2) Video/image tasks support correct model selection, explicit refresh/reconciliation, and recover from temporary status failures. (3) Office no longer remains on 'Closing'; preview-to-edit can be repeated, known Notes documents reopen in edit mode, Office remains in the current IDE tab, and File Manager expand opens the dedicated editor. (4) Local MLX releases model/Metal caches each turn, drops obsolete vision state for text turns, and performs one clean retry per turn for load/decode failures. (5) Shell has bounded output finalization and interactive Dash input. Build 198 mind-map and Magic Keyboard fixes remain included. Validation is intentionally short: focused host/source checks and one cloud App build; full UI/device acceptance is assigned to the tester. No public beta submission is included.
zh-Hans: Build 201 内部真机测试。本版替代 Build 200；Build 200 的云端 App 编译在打包／上传前发现两处 Swift 6 错误，现已修复：媒体模型解析会等待主线程路由，Office 紧凑／常规工具栏改用明确的标签样式分支。Build 199 和 200 均未上传；重新构建并核对来源的 Office 组件继续包含。请重点验证：① 手指或触控板拖动画布节点主体／标题可移动，只有可见四角调整大小。② 视频／图片任务可正确选模型、主动刷新和恢复，临时状态查询失败不会误判任务失败。③ Office 不再卡在“正在关闭”；预览转编辑可重复使用；手记中已打开过的文档再次进入默认编辑；Office 留在当前 IDE 标签内；文件管理器放大直接进入专用编辑器。④ 本地 MLX 每轮释放模型与 Metal 缓存，纯文字轮释放无用视觉状态，加载／解码失败每轮只自动清理重试一次。⑤ Shell 输出收尾有界并修复 Dash 交互输入。Build 198 的思维导图和妙控键盘修复继续包含。本轮按要求缩短验证：只做聚焦宿主／源码检查和一次云端 App 构建，完整 UI／真机验收由测试者完成。本轮不提交公开 Beta。
